findings: Benchmark checker compares mean against median of at least three historical samples, rejecting ratios strictly greater than 1.2. Missing history or insufficient per-name history skips checking. History stores last five runs.
Only current benchmark names are visited. Empty benchmark output passes even when history contains expected render benchmark; confirmed using original CLI with synthetic input.

extractMeans keys only by bench.name, ignoring file/group identity. Duplicate names overwrite earlier means; a synthetic 1000ms regression overwritten by a later 100ms same-name entry passes. Actual fixture name uniqueness remains to be inspected.
Positive control: 121ms against three 100ms historical samples exits 1 as expected.
No environment/model/browser/hardware fingerprint in history beyond commit/timestamp. Shared-runner median is not alternating paired measurement or proof of real user performance.

executed_controls.method: Original checker/helper Node CLI, synthetic JSON in isolated temporary directories.

limits: No actual benchmarks, extension build, model inference or production history modified.
